conclusion: 27/120 events (22%) resolve to at least one real, drug-name-verified candidate trial via this free dataset. A further 3 events only matched because the asset text happened to contain the company's own ticker as a generic token (e.g. NKTR-214's event matching an unrelated NKTR-102 trial, or three separate SAGE-718 events all matching the same unrelated SAGE-324 trial) - confirmed by manual spot-check, not assumed - so they are excluded from the reliable count above rather than silently accepted. Even for the reliable matches, the metadata CSV does not carry allocation/masking/intervention_model (the fields TRIAL_DESIGN actually needs - see ('allocation', 'masking', 'intervention_model')), only weaker proxies (phase, arm count, study_type). Given a genuine match rate this low and missing the specific fields the redesign was meant to make objective, this path does not clear the bar to build a full SCIENCE-redesign pipeline on top of it. RECOMMENDATION: DO_NOT_PROCEED - document this finding and do not build scripts/m7_build_science_scores.py against this data source.
match_requirement: candidate trial title (brief_title + official_title, normalized) must contain a normalized token (>=4 chars) from the event's real HistoricalEvent.asset field
